mapper.sql: select p.plan_id, p.contract_id, p.period_no, p.period_name, p.ratio, p.plan_amount, p.trigger_type, p.trigger_biz_id, p.plan_date, p.due_time, p.status, p.receive_amount, p.reduce_amount, p.settle_time, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, ct.contract_no, c.customer_name from biz_payment_plan p left join biz_contract ct on ct.contract_id = p.contract_id left join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = ct.customer_id
mapper.select:
select c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.estate, c.owner_name, c.pay_method, count(distinct ct.contract_id) as contract_count, sum(ct.contract_amount) as contract_amount, sum(p.plan_amount) as plan_amount, ifnull(sum(p.receive_amount), 0) as receive_amount, ifnull(sum(p.reduce_amount), 0) as reduce_amount, (sum(p.plan_amount) - ifnull(sum(p.receive_amount), 0) - ifnull(sum(p.reduce_amount), 0)) as remain_amount, count(p.plan_id) as period_count, sum(case when p.status in ('2', '3', '4') then 1 else 0 end) as settled_count, min(case when p.status = '1' then p.plan_date end) as next_plan_date from biz_payment_plan p inner join biz_contract ct on ct.contract_id = p.contract_id inner join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = ct.customer_id
AND c.customer_name like concat('%', #{customerName}, '%')
group by c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.estate, c.owner_name, c.pay_method
having sum(case when p.status in ('0', '1') then 1 else 0 end) = 0 having sum(case when p.status = #{status} then 1 else 0 end) > 0
order by (min(case when p.status = '1' then p.plan_date end)) is null, min(case when p.status = '1' then p.plan_date end)
where p.contract_id = #{contractId} and p.trigger_type = #{triggerType} and p.status in ('0', '1') order by p.period_no

select p.plan_id, p.contract_id, p.period_no, p.period_name, p.ratio, p.plan_amount, p.trigger_type, p.trigger_biz_id, p.plan_date, p.due_time, p.status, p.receive_amount, p.reduce_amount, p.settle_time, p.remark, ct.contract_no, c.customer_name, ou.user_id as owner_id from biz_payment_plan p left join biz_contract ct on ct.contract_id = p.contract_id left join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = ct.customer_id left join sys_user ou on ou.user_name = ct.create_by where p.status = '1' and p.plan_date <= curdate() order by p.plan_date
select count(1) from biz_payment_plan where contract_id = #{contractId} and status in ('0', '1')
mapper.update: update biz_payment_plan set status = '4', update_time = sysdate() where contract_id = #{contractId} and status in ('0', '1')
mapper.insert: insert into biz_payment_plan (contract_id, period_no, period_name, ratio, plan_amount, trigger_type, plan_date, status, receive_amount, reduce_amount, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{contractId}, #{periodNo}, #{periodName}, #{ratio}, #{planAmount}, #{triggerType}, #{planDate}, #{status}, 0, 0, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
